run_read_cam: run the script to decompose a camera projection matrix and print intrinsic, rotation, and translation
summarize_read_cam: summarize the script that loads a camera calibration file and extracts K, R, T matrices
review_read_cam: review the script that uses cv2.decomposeProjectionMatrix to extract camera parameters from a Pmat file
refactor_read_cam: refactor the script to accept the calibration file path as a command-line argument instead of a hardcoded path
create_read_cam_cli: create a CLI wrapper for the script to load any camera Pmat.cal file and print decomposed matrices
